data.name: ExecutionGuideText
data.value:
The sidebar groups conversations by workspace. Tasks are shown within the current conversation. Selecting a task or browsing branches does not change the active execution context.
Each execution record shows its state, action, duration and time. Select it to inspect command, output, source and child calls below. Use the context menu or menus to manage records in batches.
Terminating a conversation first writes the server-side gate, then cancels pending approvals and running calls. Closing this window only stops observing; it does not stop execution.
Historical tasks without steps show “Progress not recorded”. Unattributed calls retain their original call IDs and can be exported, isolated, archived or moved to trash. Permanent deletion does not delete project source code.
Shortcuts: Ctrl+F searches conversations; F5 refreshes; Esc closes details; Shift+F10 opens the selected item menu.
